svg.title: CASTAWAY: a war-room big board for a ten-hour lo-fi island video
svg.desc: Three rear-projected vector screens and a console replay a ten-hour run of Castaway at high speed: an island chart, a Pacific map with tracks arriving at one tiny island, and climbing counters. Below, a typed dialogue with the board's computer, a noughts-and-crosses game that always ends in a draw, and how to run it.
